methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible, or from a clearly-cited reputable comparison source where the vendor page returned a non-200 status or disclosed no prices. All prices are recorded at the monthly-billing rate; where a vendor only publishes an annual rate, the annualized monthly equivalent is used and notes document the annual total. annualDiscountPct is computed from the published monthly vs annual-plan monthly rate where both are disclosed, else null. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry null monthlyUsd. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 on every source.

COMPLIANCE CORRECTION: the original enrichment asserted hipaa=true sourced only from third-party review-aggregator feature checkboxes (softwareadvice.com 'HIPAA Compliant', getapp.com), with source=null. Independent verification refutes a blanket HIPAA claim for the ATS/recruiting product: (1) Paubox, a HIPAA-specialist source, concludes 'BambooHR does not sign a BAA and is therefore not HIPAA compliant' for general use (2026 update, no policy change disclosed); (2) BambooHR's own BAA is conditional — it applies only to 'Qualifying Services' that create/receive PHI (e.g. benefits administration add-ons), and the Terms of Service state the Service is not intended for PHI unless expressly authorized in writing; (3) ThirdProof notes HIPAA coverage is limited to benefits-administration scope and must be verified directly. Since this catalog covers applicant tracking (no PHI) and the HIPAA claim is unconfirmable/refuted for the ATS product, hipaa is set to null. SOC 2 and GDPR set to true: BambooHR publicly maintains SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type II via annual third-party audits (Trust Center powered by SafeBase, report available under NDA) and publishes a GDPR Data Processing Agreement (bamboohr.com/legal/data-processing-agreement) with EU-US/UK/Swiss DPF participation. compliance.source set to the BambooHR Trust Center. No forever-free plan exists; free-trial duration not published, so freeTrialDays is null.
